description: A landscaper has 2500 square feet of grass land in a customer’s backyard where they need to cut grass using either a heavy-duty yard machine or a gas lawn mower. For each square foot of land, the heavy-duty yard machine requires 2 seconds while the gas lawn mower takes 5 seconds. Per square foot, the heavy-duty yard machine produces 12 units of pollution and requires 3 units of fuel. Conversely, the gas lawn mower generates 10 units of pollution for each square foot and requires 2 units of fuel. There are 450 units of fuel available and the landscaper can produce no more than 2000 units of pollution. For how many square feet should each machine be used to minimize the time required to cut this customer’s backyard?

TotalArea.definition: Total area of grass land in square feet

TimeHeavyDuty.definition: Time required in seconds to cut one square foot of land using the heavy-duty yard machine

TimeGasMower.definition: Time required in seconds to cut one square foot of land using the gas lawn mower

PollutionHeavyDuty.definition: Pollution produced per square foot by the heavy-duty yard machine

PollutionGasMower.definition: Pollution produced per square foot by the gas lawn mower

FuelHeavyDuty.definition: Fuel required per square foot by the heavy-duty yard machine

FuelGasMower.definition: Fuel required per square foot by the gas lawn mower

objective.description: "Minimize the total time required to cut the entire 2500 square feet of grass using the two machines"

constraints.description: The total square feet cut by the heavy-duty yard machine and the gas lawn mower must equal the total area of 2500 square feet
The total fuel used by both machines must not exceed 450 units
The total pollution produced by both machines must not exceed 2000 units
The number of square feet cut by the heavy-duty yard machine must be non-negative
The number of square feet cut by the gas lawn mower must be non-negative

areaHeavyDuty.definition: Square feet of land cut using the heavy-duty yard machine

areaGasMower.definition: Square feet of land cut using the gas lawn mower
